text:
emily_pm: Quick sync — Pilot customer (Cartesian) asked for a commitment floor plus flexible surge credits that roll month-to-month. They want a simple commercial story by COB Thurs.

ryan_sales: They proposed $40k/mo minimum, then "unlimited" surges but with a predictable cap so end users don't get huge bills. Also asked for reduced tail latency during surges (priority path).

nina_finance: Unlimited surge = risk. Propose a bounded surge pool (e.g., included surge = 1.25x baseline), a rollover of unused surge up to 30%, and an overage multiplier (2.2x). Add an approval gate for any auto-increase beyond hard cap.

jacob_legal: We'll need explicit definitions in SOW: baseline, included surge, rollover rules, hard cap, approval workflow, and an early-termination remedy. Also recommend an audit clause for usage disputes.

sam_eng: Engineering notes: priority path can be a tenant-scoped queue/token bucket with a weight for priority. We'll need instrumentation to show per-tenant surge consumption and a graceful fallback to standard lane. Estimated work: 1 sprint + rollout canary to keep risk low. No kernel-level shared caches changes.

emily_pm: Draft packaging idea: "Surge Pilot" SKU — $40k/mo commit, includes 125% surge pool over baseline, 30% rollover of unused surge to next month, priority path (best-effort), and overage charged at 2.2x. Pilot length: 4 months (customer wants 3). Finance prefers 6 mo min for risk. Thoughts?

ryan_sales: Customer-friendly phrasing: call them "surge credits" and show two concrete examples (low, medium, catastrophic month) in customer doc. They want a one-page example they can show execs.

nina_finance: Example numbers we can include:
```
Baseline = 800k tokens
Included surge = 1.0M tokens (125% of baseline -> 1M)
Rollover max = 30% of unused surge
If usage = 2.2M tokens -> overage = 2.2M - 1.0M = 1.2M tokens billed @2.2x
```
Also suggest internal triggers: alert at 50% of hard cap and pricing-review at 75%. Require a 6-month minimum or an ET fee that equals 2 months of commit.

jacob_legal: I'll produce SOW snippets: surge credits definition, billing examples, approval flow for hard-cap exception, audit and data retention clause. Will need PM and finance signoff before sending to customer.

sam_eng: I'll scope a minimal dashboard widget for surge consumption and a feature flag to enable priority lane per-tenant. Will file tickets and attach rough timeline to the PR.

emily_pm: Action list: Jacob -> SOW snippets (Wed EOD); Sam -> ticket + timeline (Wed); Nina -> updated P&L + ET fee wording (Thu); Ryan -> one-pager with examples to share with Cartesian (Thu). Review sync Fri 9am PT.

ryan_sales: I'll try to nudge Cartesian to accept the 4->6 month tradeoff if we give a small onboarding credit. :+1: 

nina_finance: If pilot usage grows rapidly, auto-escalate to commercial review and pause rollover until contract amendment. We'll model worst-case scenarios.

jacob_legal: Noted. I'll add a clause that temporarily suspends rollover if usage exceeds a defined threshold until amendment signed.

emily_pm: Good. We want a lightweight pilot offer but need robust guardrails to protect MRR. Thanks team — I'll compile the package after inputs.
